title: Aligning LLM agents with human learning and adjustment behavior: A dual agent approach
journal: Transportation Research Part C: Emerging Technologies
authors: Tianming Liu; Jirong Yang; Yafeng Yin; Manzi Li; Linghao Wang; Zheng Zhu
abstract: Effective modeling of how human travelers learn and adjust their travel behavior from interacting with transportation systems is critical for system assessment and planning. However, this task is also difficult due to the complex cognition and decision-making involved in such behavior. Recent research has begun to leverage Large Language Model (LLM) agents for this task. Building on this, we introduce a novel dual-agent framework that enables continuous learning and alignment between LLM agents and human travelers in learning and adaptation behavior from online data streams. Our approach involves a set of LLM traveler agents, equipped with a memory system and a learnable persona, which serve as simulators for human travelers. To ensure behavioral alignment, we introduce an LLM calibration agent that leverages the reasoning and analytical capabilities of LLMs to train the personas of these traveler agents. Working together, this dual-agent system is designed to track and align the underlying decision-making mechanisms of travelers and produce realistic, adaptive simulations. Using a real-world dataset from a day-to-day route choice experiment, we show our approach significantly outperforms existing methods in individual behavior alignment and LLM-based methods in aggregate flow prediction performance. Furthermore, we demonstrate that our method moves beyond simple behavioral mimicry to capture the evolution of underlying learning processes, which contributes to robust generalization. Overall, our framework provides a new approach for creating adaptive and behaviorally realistic agents to simulate travelers’ learning and adaptation that can benefit transportation simulation and policy analysis.
abstractZh: 有效建模人类出行者如何通过与交通系统互动学习并调整出行行为，对系统评估与规划至关重要。然而，这类行为涉及复杂认知和决策，使建模十分困难。近期研究开始利用大语言模型（LLM）智能体处理这一任务。在此基础上，我们提出新的双智能体框架，利用在线数据流，使LLM智能体在学习和适应行为方面持续学习并与人类出行者对齐。该方法包含一组配备记忆系统和可学习人格设定的LLM出行者智能体，作为人类出行者的模拟器。为确保行为对齐，框架引入LLM校准智能体，利用其推理与分析能力训练出行者智能体的人格设定。两个部分协同工作，跟踪并对齐出行者的底层决策机制，生成真实且自适应的模拟。利用逐日路径选择实验的真实数据集，我们表明，该方法在个体行为对齐方面显著优于现有方法，在聚合流量预测方面优于其他LLM方法。此外，该方法超越简单行为模仿，能够捕捉底层学习过程的演变，从而支持稳健泛化。总体而言，该框架为构建适应性强、行为真实的智能体以模拟出行者学习和适应提供了新方法，可服务于交通模拟及政策分析。
summary: 以出行者智能体和校准智能体构成双智能体框架，通过文本伪梯度和画像平滑，在线校准个体学习与路径调整行为；在15人160轮路径选择实验上评估个体决策及聚合流量。
